local_checks.invariant: Bodies, limiter keys and DB work have per-item and aggregate bounds
local_checks.result: express.json has a 10 kB limit (body-parser enforces it after decompression), and other content types are never buffered. Page limit is at most 100 and the cursor at most 200 characters. The MemoryRateLimiter map grows by one entry per distinct key and is swept once per minute of expired windows. Keys are IP (1-minute window) or authenticated student id (15 minutes), so retained state is linear in the attacker's own request rate with no amplification. The pg pool is max 10, and unauthenticated /readyz runs a constant select 1. There is no superlinear or persistent shared effect, so the remaining items are hardening (no pool connection or statement timeout).
